title: Rap Diss
text: Controversial rapper Psycho Loke is in hiding after being shot at yesterday by his former friend, rapper Baby D. His fans are wondering how and when he'll respond. Hell yeah, Psycho Loke in this bitch. And this track is dedicated to my former homie Baby D. That fool tried to smoke me yesterday. Well I guess you missed fool, cause I'm still here. Hell yeah, tried to set me up for a 1A7. Guess you heard I was getting freaky with your baby mama while you was in jail. Ha ha, you think I'ma just sit back and you try and kill me? Hell no, I'm about to say something I should've said a long ass time ago. Check this out. I'm sorry , I'm sorry. I was wrong , I'm sorry. I'm sorry for the way that I made you feel. This is straight from the heart so you know it's real. Oh what's the matter fool? You wasn't expecting an apology from a gangster like me? Yeah, well I wasn't expecting a near death experience while leaving Walmart. And you scared the by me fool. I left my full shopping cart in the middle of the parking lot. I had a flat screen in there buster. And now you still wanna kill me? I can't sleep that night and my skin's breaking out. My stomach's in knots and I mean don't get it twisted. I ain't no bitch. I'm just realizing that you seem a lot madder than I am. And I'm not even really sure why. Cause you heard I snitched on you. You got it all wrong fool. I ain't have to tell the police nothing. Cause the cops already knew stuff. I just told them they was right. And a couple other small things and I swear that's it. Now is that snitching? Maybe just a little bit. That's why I'm saying I'm sorry. You ain't never been sorry. Even Tupac's been sorry. Yeah. But the only thing I won't apologize for. Is tapping your baby mama's ass. Cause we're in love now and wanna start a family. Maybe get a little house and be happy. Become a real unit. Something I never had. Your kid called me dad by mistake. And I'm sorry. I didn't correct him and I wanna say I'm sorry. Hell yeah. I bet you think this is all a setup. Nope mother I'm sorry. Truly really sorry. Please don't kill me. I got a lot to live for. Uh. Like your little man. He's gonna need a dad. Cause you going to jail. Cause I told the police. Well I didn't really tell them. I just wrote it down. They picked it up and read it. You can't blame me for that. Uh. I just want some sleep. I miss being your friend. I wish I could see you. Oh snap. There you are. Hey man. I'm glad you're here. I just feel really awful. About everything I spent. Holy . Uh. Yeah that's fair.
